questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

______ of the two contestants was willing to withdraw from the tournament.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'Neither.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• We use **none of **with a singular verb when it is the subject.

 
 
• जब यह विषय होता है तो हम एकवचन क्रिया के साथ **none of** का उपयोग करते हैं।.

 
 
• **Example**:** *****None of **that surprises me. *
 
 
 
 
 
• **'Neither' **refers to not one out of the two in a group, while **'none'** refers to not even one in a group of more than two things.
 
 
• 'Neither' एक समूह में **"दो में से एक ****को नहीं"** दर्शाता है, जबकि 'none ' दो से अधिक चीजों के समूह में** "एक भी नहीं"** को दर्शाता है।
 
 
 
• We use **neither of** with a singular verb when it is the subject.
 
 
• जब यह विषय होता है तो हम एकवचन क्रिया के साथ neither of का उपयोग करते हैं।​
 
 
• Example:* **Neither of **my best friends was around.*
 
 
 
 
 
• **No one and nobody** mean the same.
 
 
• No one and nobody का मतलब एक ही है।
 
 
 
• **Nobody** is a little less formal than **no one**.
 
 
• **Nobody,** **no one** से थोड़ा कम औपचारिक है। 
 
 
• **Example**:* I knew** nobody** at the party.

 ** No one** moved; **no one** said anything.

 ​*
 
 
 
 

Correct sentence__: *Neither **of the two contestants was willing to withdraw from the tournament.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

 

 
• A **pronoun **is a word that is used instead of a noun or noun phrase.
 
• Pronouns refer to either a noun that has already been mentioned or to a noun that does not need to be named specifically.
 
• The main possessive pronouns are** mine, yours, his, hers, its, ours**, and **theirs**.

• The rule for changing a Present Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + is/am/are + v1 + ing + object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 __
 
• *Esha is singing a song.** *(Active Voice)

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, the sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: *He reads a novel. *(Active Voice)

 * A novel is read by him. *(Passive Voice)*​*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

• Object और Subject को एक दूसरे के साथ बदलें, यानी Active Voice का object, Passive Voice का subject बन जाती है।
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + is/am/are + v1 + ing + object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha is singing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• A song is being sung by Esha.* *(Passive Voice)

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The doctor said, "The patient is out of danger now."

options.text: The doctor said that the patient is out of danger then.
The doctor said that the patient was out of danger now.
The doctor said that the patient was out of danger then.
The doctor said that the patient is out of danger now.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** '​The doctor said that the patient was out of danger then.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Simple Present Tense. 
 
• The rules of Direct and Indirect speech for interrogative sentence conversions.
 
• The reporting verb said/said to is changed in asked, demanded, ordered, and enquired as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be used.
 
• The first person in reported speech changes according to the subject of reporting speech.
 
• In Reported Speech, the change of the second person depends on the object of reporting speech.
 
• The third person remains unchanged.
 
• **Now** changes to **then**.
 
• Simple Present Tense converts to Simple Past Tense.
 
• Structure__: (Subject+ V1+ object) (Direct Speech)

 (Subject+ V2 + object) (Indirect Speech)
 __
 
• Example: *Navin said, “He is young.”*
 
 

* Navin said that he was young. *

**Correct Sentence:**__ *The doctor said that the patient was out of danger then.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• If the reporting verb is in the past tense, then the direct sentence is changed in its past tense.
 
• If the direct sentence contains the universal truth, then it remains unchanged in the Indirect Speech.
 
• The tense of direct speech remains unchanged when the reporting verb is in the present or future tense.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Simple Present Tense में है।
 
• प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य रूपांतरण के लिए प्रत्यक्ष और अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण के नियम।
 
• Simple Present Tense, Simple Past Tense में कनवर्ट करता है।
 
• इसमें '**that**' शब्द का प्रयोग होगा।
 
• रिपोर्ट किए गए भाषण में first person रिपोर्टिंग भाषण के विषय के अनुसार बदलता है।
 
• रिपोर्टेड स्पीच में second person का परिवर्तन रिपोर्टिंग स्पीच के उद्देश्य पर निर्भर करता है।
 
• Third person अपरिवर्तित रहता है।
 
• **Now**, **then **में बदल जाता है।
 
• Structure__: (Subject+ V1+object) (Direct Speech)

 (Subject+ V2+ object) (Indirect Speech)
 
 
• Example: *Navin said, “He is young.”*
 
 

* Navin said that he was young. *

• Hence, the preposition 'by' should be replaced by the preposition 'to' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
 
• इसलिए, वाक्य को व्याकरणिक रूप से सही बनाने के लिए preposition 'by' को preposition 'to' द्वारा प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए।

I couldn't understand why he was **__so angry upon me__**.
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• There are three articles: *a, an, and the.*

 
 
• Indefinite article 'an': before a singular noun beginning with a vowel sound whose specific identity is not known.
 
• Definite article 'the': before a singular or plural noun whose specific identity is known.
 
• Indefinite article 'a': before a singular noun beginning with a consonant sound whose specific identity is not known.

__
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given words:
 
 
• **Lest: **Used ​to denote in order to prevent something from happening. (कुछ होने से रोकने के लिए निरूपित करने के लिए **lest **प्रयोग किया जाता है)

• **Since:** Used with a point in time in the past. (अतीत में एक समय के साथ प्रयोग किया जाता है)
 
 
• **Example:** *They've lived in Oxford** since **2004.*
 
 
 
• **Whether: **Used in reference to a choice or alternatives. (किसी विकल्प या विकल्प के संदर्भ में प्रयुक्त।)
 
 
• **Example:** *We're going **whether** it rains or not.*
 
 
 
• **Unless: **We use the conjunction **unless** to mean **‘except if’.** (**unless** का अर्थ है ‘**जब तक**’।) 
 
 
• **Example:*** You can't get a job **unless **you have experience.*
 
 
 
 
 
• **Meaning of the sentence** in Hindi -* ***जब तक** वह सभी शर्तों को पूरा नहीं करता, उसे ठेका नहीं दिया जाना चाहिए।
